## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (formatting and tests).
- [ ] The attribution comment at the top of `mouse-scroll-cue.svg` is intact.
- [ ] If `mouse-scroll-cue.svg` changed, `npm run build:preview` was run and `media/preview.svg` is committed.
- [ ] If the cue looks or moves differently, the change was discussed in an issue first and `NOTICE.md` lists it under "Changes".
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched (release-please generates it).
